title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E26 — Winter Passage
Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E27 — The Reckoning
More unrest between the white men and the Ottawas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E28 — La Salle's Treasure
Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle; they ask Hawkeye to lead them but when he discovers that it is in a sacred Dakota burial ground he tries to dissuade them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E29 — The Prisoner
Lt. Briggs breaks the treaty by chasing an Indian beyond the recognized border; led into an ambush he escapes but his militiamen are captured; Hawkeye and Chingachgook are assigned to escort him to his court-martial and probable hanging.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E30 — False Faces
A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent Mingo False Faces.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E31 — Morristown Story
Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away and told that the town is closed due to an outbreak of the black plague; Hawkeye decides to sneak in and see for himself.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E32 — Revenge
A young lieutenant seeks blind vengeance for the brutal murders of his parents by warmongering Shawnee.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E33 — The Contest
Hawkeye and Chingachgook match their wits against two thieves who have phony identities.

title: The Man From Music Mountain
description: A singing rancher (Gene Autry) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch swindlers selling lots in a ghost town.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Blue Steel
description: Marshal John Carruthers helps a sheriff find out who stole the town's payroll, and together they discover the town's leader stole the money to buy up all the land.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: Raiders of Old California
description: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
description: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Fast Bullets
description: Two Texas Rangers (Tom Tyler, Rex Lease) nab smugglers and rescue a woman (Margaret Nearing) from a runaway wagon.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Rawhide Rangers
description: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Under Western Stars
description: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

title: Colorado Sundown
description: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: The Outlaw
description: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Leather Burners
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) helps his friend Johnny (Jay Kirby) find out where rustlers are hiding stolen cattle.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Light of Western Stars
description: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: Hands Across the Border
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.
